text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — POC kickoff with Helix scheduled TOMORROW 10:00am PT. Main asks: confirm success criteria, approve eval prompt set, answer security questionnaire, and pricing model for a 3-week pilot. Agenda below. @maria_solutions @trent_eng @sophie_security @devon_product can you join? Customer contact: @julie_helix

maria_solutions: I'll be there. Can we get their top 3 use cases by EOD? Also need sample prompts to run our eval harness.

julie_helix: Thanks Alex — confirmed 10am. Our use cases: 1) Triage customer support tickets -> automated summaries; 2) Legal doc redaction; 3) Internal knowledge search with embeddings. We'll DM the prompt examples shortly.

trent_eng: For infra: are they okay with hosted API or do they require private? If private, we need lead time for VPC setup (2 business days) + certs. Also what's expected max qps?

sophie_security: Please send over their completed security questionnaire (SOC2 / data classification) beforehand. If PHI or sensitive PII involved, we need DPA + specific retention settings. Also: is helix-legal@helix.com covered by the NDA?

devon_product: Propose success criteria: precision >= 0.80 on redaction eval, avg generation latency < 400ms (95th pct) for hosted route, and 80% intent classification accuracy for ticket triage. Agree?

julie_helix: NDA is in place. Not PHI, but there is PII (emails, names). QPS: ~30 peak. We prefer hosted but need IP/data isolation for some artifacts. Pricing: what's the delta between hosted usage and a short-term dedicated pool for a 3-week trial?

alex_sales: Hosted trial = usage-based, no commit. Dedicated = monthly commit/minimum. For trials, we can provision a temporary reserved pool at a discounted trial rate — I'll pull finance for a quote and a short-term contract template.

trent_eng: For the latency target we'll likely want prefix caching + batching. Suggest starting config: prefix cache = 8 tokens, batch size = 16, autoscale min=1 / max=4 GPU nodes for trial window. That should meet ~400ms 95p for our Llama-family variants.

maria_solutions: I'll assemble the eval prompt set. Julie — can you share ~50 sample tickets and ~10 legal docs for redaction tests? We'll run them through our eval harness and share the dashboard before kickoff.

julie_helix: Uploading samples to the shared bucket now: https://s3.redwood-sandbox/helix/poc-samples (link expires in 7 days).

deploy-bot: Reminder: infra request created #infra-requests/1733333000 — lead time estimate 48h.

sophie_security: Quick checklist for Julie: 1) completed security questionnaire (PDF); 2) network diagram; 3) data flow / classification statement; 4) retention/erasure policy; 5) incident response contact. If you can drop those in the bucket we'll start the review.

devon_product: Also add an embeddings success metric: MRR > 0.75 on knowledge search queries (eval set to be shared).

alex_sales: Next steps summary: Maria to assemble prompt set + run initial eval by EOD today; Trent to confirm infra config & cost estimate; Sophie to kick off security review once docs are uploaded; I'll get trial pricing quote and short-term contract. Confirmed attendees for the call: Alex, Maria, Trent, Sophie, Devon, Julie. Anything else?

maria_solutions: One more ask — can we have a 5–7 minute demo script for the kickoff showcasing ticket triage -> summary -> suggested reply? I'll draft it and share in the shared bucket.

julie_helix: Sounds good, thanks everyone. See you tomorrow 10am PT.
